_comment: Complete enumeration: every act1 checkpoint that exists on disk was rolled through the only
cross-act branch (the retained-trace seed). Ten V1-contract checkpoints cannot be loaded
against the V2 observation space and are recorded as skips rather than silently dropped --
the first version of this sweep crashed on the first of them and produced no artifact at all.

field_corrections.now: full sha256 of the file named by the row's own `checkpoint` path
field_corrections.why: a prefix under a field named sha256 cannot be verified, and the evidence manifest scans only 64-hex values, so these rows were invisible to every digest check

frontier: Act 2 floor 22 (deepest of the whole repository); no checkpoint cleared Act 2
open_questions: ANSWERED from source (RunEngine.cs:1953-1979, :1984-1997): the demo seed's Act-2 route is a four-floor scripted strip -- TryChooseRetainedTraceActTwoPath only defines encounter ids for floors 18, 19, 20, 21 (33 Tunneler, 35 Thieving Hopper, 37 Bowlbugs, 4 Exoskeletons) and teleports the cursor to column 3, rows 1-4. From floor 22 it returns false and the run continues on the freshly generated 17-row Act-2 map, where Floor is offset by 17, so that map's boss row 16 is exactly floor 33 = terminalFloor. So floor 33 is not a stray constant: it is the chained Act-2 boss floor, reachable in principle but requiring the generated map's edges from (3,4) onward to keep connecting. Observed frontier over 84 checkpoints: floor 22, with two runs losing their map successors at floor 19, i.e. the scripted strip ends and the generated connectivity does not continue. Original question: what node is Act 2 terminal for a chained run: the chain resets Floor to 17 (RunEngine.cs:1909-1914) and content is observed up to floor 22, but the assumed floor-33 boss was never reached or verified

ANSWERED by chained_terminal_gates_20260919.json: the two floor-19 truncations are map exhaustion, not the boss-exit family -- evaluate_policy classifies them empty_action_mask and their terminal states advertise zero successor nodes at floor 19 (37/77 HP). Same reason string, different cause: the boss-exit class ends at floor 17 right after clearing a NodeBoss node.
whether the demo seed is representative: only 3 of 74 checkpoints cleared its Act 1 boss, while named Act 1 victories exist on ordinary seeds
